reuse.why: Builds on the existing SQL filters and getBudgetData, but does not pull the repeated category-selection query into a shared helper.

duplication.why: The 'AND c.goal_def IS NULL' rule is pasted into four separate SQL strings, setZero gets yet another copy of the hidden-filter query, and copyPreviousMonth carries its own JS form of the rule.

placement.why: The edits stay in budget/actions.ts, where the month-wide actions live.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and one test change.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule now exists in five places, in two forms (SQL and JS); the next rule change has to edit all of them consistently.

disguised_duplication.where: The rule appears as SQL WHERE clauses in setZero/set3/6/12MonthAvg and as a reshaped if-condition (goal_def !== null) in copyPreviousMonth

one_place.where: Hidden/template exclusion is written in each of setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg (SQL) and copyPreviousMonth (JS)
